component.name: Voice Changer
component.summary: Realtime voice changer that shows up as a microphone

description.p: Voice Changer processes your microphone in real time and publishes the result as a new PipeWire microphone called "Voice Changer Mic", so Discord, SIP clients, OBS and anything else can simply select it. The same engine also loads as a CLAP plugin in DAWs.

ul.li: Natural pitch and formant shifting (pitch-synchronous, the technique hardware voice transformers use) plus phase-vocoder modes
Drive, robot, echo, reverb and tone effects with ready-made voices: Man, Woman, Baritone, Bass, Deep, Demon, Monster, Chipmunk, Robot, Radio, Cave, Announcer
Local AI voice conversion with RVC v2 models, including retrieval indices, on the CPU or an AMD GPU
Neural noise suppression and a voice-only gate before everything else
One big on/off switch: window, tray icon, global shortcut or the command line
Hear-myself monitoring, presets, favourites, and a voice library that imports from a pasted link

screenshot.caption: Home: presets, quick tweaks and the AI voice card
Voices: import and manage AI voice models
Effects: pitch engine and effect panels
Settings: microphone, window behaviour, hotkey and logs

description.p: First release: natural pitch engine, effects, presets, AI voices with retrieval index, GPU support, iced interface, tray, hotkey, D-Bus and CLI.
